# Isaiah Chapter 33 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 24 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Destroyer destroyed; God exalted; sinners in Zion tremble; eyes see the king; Zion at peace*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**Woe to the Destroyer:** Destroyer destroyed; God exalted; sinners in Zion tremble; eyes see the king; Zion at peace. The key message for modern readers: "Your eyes will see the king in his beauty; they will behold a land that stretches afar"

*-- PNEUMA*
